# Liar's Dice

> Free online Liar's Dice (Dudo / Perudo): play instantly in the browser against AI, no download or account required. Official-style rules, strategy, history, and FAQ.

Liar's Dice Online is a public-domain bluffing dice game. Each player hides dice under a cup, bids on how many of a face value are on the table (aces are usually wild), and can challenge a bluff or call Spot On. This site ships a playable single-player game plus long-form guides.

## Play

- [Play Liar's Dice](https://liars-dice.app/play): Start a free game against AI opponents in your browser

## Learn

- [How to Play](https://liars-dice.app/how-to-play): Step-by-step beginner tutorial for bidding, challenges, and winning
- [Rules](https://liars-dice.app/rules): Complete official-style rules, wild aces, palifico, and Spot On
- [Strategy](https://liars-dice.app/strategy): Probability, bluffing timing, and practical bidding tips
- [FAQ](https://liars-dice.app/faq): Common questions about rules, equipment, and this free online version

## Variants & history

- [Dudo & Perudo Rules](https://liars-dice.app/dudo-perudo-rules): Regional names and rule differences for Dudo and Perudo
- [Compare Variants](https://liars-dice.app/compare): Side-by-side comparison of common Liar's Dice variants
- [History](https://liars-dice.app/history): Origins of Dudo, Perudo, and the modern game
